name: work-placements
description: Find, contact and follow the companies where your students do their work placements: companies by sector from OpenStreetMap (and Google Places with your key), their public sites read, a local record of companies and contacts with its follow-ups, CSV and Excel for the department, and one email draft per company that you review and send.

area.title: Your area
area.description: Where to look for companies when you don't say: a town or a region, e.g. La Laguna, Tenerife. Empty: the agent asks.

places_key.title: Google Places API key (optional)
places_key.description: Your own key for Google's Places API (New), to search Google Maps' businesses too. Empty: only OpenStreetMap.

output_dir.title: Folder for drafts and exports
output_dir.description: Where email drafts and spreadsheets are written, e.g. C:\Users\you\Documents\work-placements. Empty: Documents/work-placements.

description.es: Busca, contacta y sigue a las empresas donde tu alumnado hace sus prácticas: empresas por sector de OpenStreetMap (y de Google Places con tu clave), sus webs públicas leídas, un registro local de empresas y contactos con sus seguimientos, CSV y Excel para el departamento, y un borrador de correo por empresa que revisas y envías tú.

en.label: Finding placement companies
en.description: Companies by sector in your town or around it, from OpenStreetMap and, with your key, Google Places; their websites read for a generic email and a phone; and those you already have, never repeated.

es.label: Buscar empresas de prácticas
es.description: Empresas por sector en tu municipio o alrededor, de OpenStreetMap y, con tu clave, de Google Places; sus webs leídas para un correo genérico y un teléfono; y las que ya tienes, sin repetirlas.

en.label: Contacting companies
en.description: One email draft per company from your own letter, to its generic address, that opens unsent in Outlook or Thunderbird for you to review and send; and your calls and visits noted.

es.label: Contactar con empresas
es.description: Un borrador de correo por empresa a partir de tu propia carta, a su dirección genérica, que se abre sin enviar en Outlook o Thunderbird para que lo revises y lo envíes; y tus llamadas y visitas anotadas.

en.label: Following placement companies
en.description: Where each company stands, from to contact to hosting students, who to write to or call today, and the record for the department in Excel or CSV.

es.label: Seguir a las empresas de prácticas
es.description: En qué punto está cada empresa, de por contactar a con alumnado, a quién escribir o llamar hoy, y el registro para el departamento en Excel o CSV.

agent-kit.help: Work placements: I find companies by sector in your area (OpenStreetMap, and Google Places with your key), read their public websites for a generic email and a phone, keep your record of companies and contacts on this computer with its follow-ups, import and export it as Excel or CSV, and write one email draft per company from your own letter. I send nothing: you review and send each draft. My skills are work-placements:find-companies, company-outreach, placement-tracker and linkedin-and-sites.
